audit_question: Which battle strata, parent action families, and Q-margin regimes account for the guarded successor's residual battle-9 regression after aggregate performance moved near parity with production r16?
registered_outputs: guarded-candidate action disagreement count and rate
disagreement rate by battle index and parent action family
parent and candidate selected action-family counts
parent Q-margin summaries for agreeing and disagreeing states
parent-selected Q delta and candidate advantage on flipped states

interpretation_rules.battle_9_concentration: Compare battle 9 disagreement against battles 0, 3, and 6 without attributing matched outcome causality.
interpretation_rules.end_turn_residual: Measure parent non-end-turn to candidate end-turn flips separately from same-family action changes.
interpretation_rules.objective_followup: Define another objective only if one repeated action-family boundary is materially concentrated; otherwise stop objective patching and revisit targets or state representation.

stop_rules: Run the fresh-state audit once and do not reuse its cohort for a tuned rerun.
Do not change candidates, behavior seed, state cohort, bounds, or output definitions after state access.
Do not train, fit, update, interpolate, package, promote, or start Slay the Spire or CommunicationMod.
The audit grants no policy-quality or production authority.
